task.title: Navigate settings categories
task.shortdesc: Navigate All settings categories and mapped control clusters to find related policy and preference controls.

prereq.p: Open All settings in Configured or Catalog mode.

context.p: Categories group settings by product domain rather than by file location. They help users move between browser access, privacy, search, extensions, raw/unmapped, and other clusters.

step.cmd: Open the category navigation or catalog summary.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose the domain or cluster that matches the configuration goal.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Review category counts for configured, attention, raw, or deprecated settings.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Open a setting detail or switch filters without losing the category context.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: You can move through the settings inventory by product domain and reach the relevant detail panel.

postreq.p: Recovery: if a category does not contain the expected control, search by policy ID or inspect raw/unmapped items.
